definitions.explanation: An area close to a reference point. As a noun, refers to the surrounding area.
Approximately or almost a certain amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a convenience store near the school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：10079_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいます→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Children are playing near the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}り→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}っています→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: There's a big library near my house, and I go there every week to borrow books.

examples.japanese: ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{近|ちか}く⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It cost nearly a thousand yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{近|ちか}く⟦{待|ま}ちました→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I waited for nearly two hours.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}わらせる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧{近|ちか}く⟦かかりました→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took nearly a week to finish this work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{近|ちか}く⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくなって→無くなる：01101_nakunaru⟧⟦しまいました→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I spent nearly a million yen, so my savings are gone.

notes:
{近|ちか}く is the noun form of the adjective ⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧ (close, near). It functions as both a noun meaning "vicinity" and an adverb meaning "nearly."

USAGE AS NOUN (vicinity):
- [place]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く: near [place]
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{近|ちか}く: near here, in this area
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live near the station

USAGE AS ADVERB (nearly):
- [number]{近|ちか}く: nearly [number]
- ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{近|ちか}く: nearly 1000 yen
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{近|ちか}く: nearly two hours

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧: neighborhood
- ⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: vicinity (more formal)
